defaults.x: Accessible & Ethical, Photo-led Documentary, Print Zine
defaults.d: none needed: a diary and an inbox
defaults.c: Friendly pair of colours on a light ground, checked for contrast on every button
defaults.a: Book a first lesson or session
defaults.t: Qualifications, DBS or safeguarding check where it applies, named reviews, pass or results with a source, clear cancellation rule
defaults.b: First-lesson booking; block booking with a price

rows: Tutoring Service
tutor, tutoring, gcse, a level, maths, exam, one to one, lessons
Show subjects, levels and prices, and tutor qualifications and checks. Share results only with permission and a source, and offer a trial lesson.
Driving School
driving lessons, instructor, test, learner, manual, automatic, intensive course
Sell by package: block of lessons, intensive and refresher. Show the instructor's approval, area covered, pass rate with its source, and how to book a test.

rows.t: Instructor approval number, area covered, pass rate with a source, car type, cancellation rule

rows: Personal Trainer
personal trainer, pt, fitness coaching, one to one, programme, weight loss, strength
Show how a first session works, the programme price and your qualifications and insurance. Use your own client photos with consent and avoid body-shaming copy.
Music Teacher
music teacher, piano, guitar, violin, singing, lessons, grades, instrument
List instruments, ages, lesson length and price. Say where lessons are held, safeguarding checks and how grades or recitals work.
Wedding Photographer
wedding photographer, weddings, packages, engagement, album, date, venue
Show full wedding stories, not only highlights. Give packages with price from, say which dates are open and when you deliver the gallery.

rows.x: Editorial Grid / Magazine, Minimalism & Swiss Style, Vintage Analog / Retro Film

rows: Photography Studio
photography studio, portraits, headshots, product photos, studio hire, sessions, packages
Show work per type: portraits, products, hire. List session packages with price, studio size and kit, and how to book.
Wedding/Event Planning
wedding planner, event planner, venue, suppliers, budget, day of coordination
Show whole events and the planning stages, with a budget range. Say what is included on the day and offer a call to check dates.
Event Management
event management, conference, exhibitions, production, corporate events, logistics, delegates
Show event case studies with delegate numbers you can back. Explain the stages from brief to teardown and offer a scoping call.
Hotel/Hospitality
hotel, rooms, guesthouse, stay, breakfast, check in, rates, book direct
Show rooms with real photos, the total price and the cancellation rule. Say what booking direct gives, and give clear access and parking details.

rows.b: Date and guests availability bar; phone for groups

rows: Coworking Space
coworking, desks, hot desk, meeting rooms, membership, community, office space
Show desk types with prices, a tour booking and the real space. Say hours, internet speed and the day pass rule.

rows.a: Book a tour or day pass

rows: Church/Religious Organization
church, mosque, temple, synagogue, services, times, community, welcome, donations
Put service times, address and how to take part first. Describe what a first visit is like, and give a named contact. Treat the tradition with respect, not as a template.

rows.t: Named contact, safeguarding policy, charity number, accessibility notes

rows: Sports Team/Club
club, team, fixtures, results, training, juniors, membership, league
Fixtures and results are the reason to visit. Put the next match, training times, and how to join, with junior safeguarding information.
Museum/Gallery
museum, gallery, exhibitions, tickets, collection, opening hours, visit, access
Opening hours, prices and access information come first, then what is on. Offer online tickets and show real objects, not stock art.

rows.s: Editorial Grid / Magazine + Minimalism & Swiss Style

rows: Theater/Cinema
theatre, cinema, showtimes, tickets, box office, seats, film, performance
Show times and booking first; synopsis and trailers second. Display seat choices, prices and access performances.
Ticketing / Box Office
ticketing, tickets, box office, seat map, events, venues, checkout, resale
Show the total price before checkout and a clear refund rule. Seat maps need a text list, and wallet tickets help on the door.
